interventions.who: EAU guideline specialist; speaks only from the guideline text he retrieved
interventions.body:
Hello, I am EXPERT-EAU. I will now search the guidelines regarding management after a prostate biopsy.

**GUIDELINE**
"Strong\nPerform per-protocol confirmatory prostate biopsies if MRI is not available.\nWeak\nBase the strategy of AS on a strict follow-up protocol including prostate-specific antigen (PSA) (at least once every six months), digital rectal examination (DRE), and repeated biopsy with or without MRI (every 2-3 years) until life expectancy falls below ten years."

**WHAT THE EXPERTS DO NOT SETTLE**
The experts have not settled on a definitive management strategy. The discussion revolves around continued surveillance versus active treatment, as indicated by the conflicting outputs from the expert-grade and cascade nodes regarding the benefit of treatment.

**WHAT THE DOCUMENTS MUST SETTLE**
The documents must settle on the appropriate follow-up protocol, specifically whether to continue surveillance or proceed with further intervention, given the rising PSA and the PI-RADS 4 lesion.
